knowledge:
- key_parameters: high_base_quality=Cutoff for high-quality base counts (e.g., 23L), used by the likelihood ratio test ;; indels=Logical, whether to detect indels (e.g., TRUE or FALSE) ;; read_length=Length of reads (e.g., 75L), necessary for one of the QA filters ;; which=Genomic ranges to restrict the tallying ;; mask=GRanges object specifying regions to mask out (e.g., low complexity repeats) ;; fisher.strand.p.value=P-value cutoff for the Fisher Exact Test for strand bias (default 0.001) ;; read.count=Minimum read count for calling filters (e.g., 3L) ;; power=Power threshold for wildtype calling (e.g., 0.85) or somatic calling (e.g., 0.9) ;; p.value=P-value threshold for somatic calling (e.g., 0.001)
- alternatives: samtools mpileup=Generates statistics useful for variant calling ;; vcfutils=Perl script for filtering mpileup output ;; Varscan2=Series of adhoc filters on mpileup output ;; GATK=Oriented towards genotyping in diploid samples ;; Comparative somatic callers (e.g., strelka, MuTect)=For somatic mutation calling, though VariantTools also supports sample-specific calling
- when_to_use: Use when calling single nucleotide variants (SNVs) and indels from high-throughput sequencing data (WGS, Exome-seq, RNA-seq), especially when sensitive detection of low-frequency variants is needed (e.g., in heterogeneous, aneuploid, or contaminated samples) and when robust QA filtering is desired.
- pitfalls: Running variant calling without detailed QC of tally results (highly recommended to use QA filters) ;; Missing read_length parameter in TallyVariantsParam which is required for the median distance from nearest end (mdfne) QA filter ;; Missing non-missing sample names when exporting to VCF (will fail or produce invalid VCF) ;; Using VCF class for intermediate steps (VRanges/tally GRanges is preferred because it has a separate record for each ALT at each position, unlike VCF which collapses them) ;; Failing to pass the exact same filters to callWildtype that were used to call the variants, which is required for consistency

workflows.name: single_sample_calling
workflows.intent: Call single-sample variants from a BAM file, apply QA and calling filters, post-filter, and export the results to a VCF file.
workflows.stages: 1. Define tally parameters using TallyVariantsParam ;; 2. Tally variants from BAM using tallyVariants ;; 3. Apply QA filters using qaVariants ;; 4. Call variants using callVariants ;; 5. Post-filter variants using postFilterVariants ;; 6. Export called variants to VCF using asVCF and writeVcf
workflows.code:
tally.param <- TallyVariantsParam(gmapR::TP53Genome(), 
                                  high_base_quality = 23L,
                                  which = range(p53) + 5e4,
                                  indels = TRUE, read_length = 75L)
tallies_H1993 <- tallyVariants(bam, tally.param)
qa.variants <- qaVariants(tallies_H1993)
called.variants <- callVariants(qa.variants)
pf.variants <- postFilterVariants(called.variants)
sampleNames(called.variants) <- "H1993"
mcols(called.variants) <- NULL
vcf <- asVCF(called.variants)
writeVcf(vcf, "H1993.vcf", index = TRUE)

workflows.name: somatic_variant_calling
workflows.intent: Call sample-specific (e.g., somatic tumor vs. normal) variants from case and control BAM files.
workflows.stages: 1. Define tally parameters using TallyVariantsParam ;; 2. Call sample-specific variants using callSampleSpecificVariants
workflows.code:
tally.param@bamTallyParam@indels <- FALSE
somatic <- callSampleSpecificVariants(bams$H1993, bams$H2073,
                                      tally.param)
calling.filters <- VariantCallingFilters(read.count = 3L)
somatic <- callSampleSpecificVariants(bams$H1993, bams$H2073, tally.param,
                                      calling.filters = calling.filters,
                                      power = 0.9, p.value = 0.001)

workflows.name: wildtype_calling
workflows.intent: Determine which non-variant positions have sufficient coverage to be confidently called wildtype.
workflows.stages: 1. Filter out indels from called variants using isIndel ;; 2. Define positions of interest ;; 3. Call wildtype status using callWildtype
workflows.code:
called.variants <- called.variants[!isIndel(called.variants)]
pos <- c(called.variants, shift(called.variants, 3))
wildtype <- callWildtype(bam, called.variants, VariantCallingFilters(), 
                         pos = pos, power = 0.85)
